spec.label: Spesifikasyon
spec.goal: Understand the circuit: extract the role of each port, a circuit summary and assumptions.

scenario.label: Test senaryosu
scenario.goal: Decide which testbench to build for each selected analysis. Use only the analyses listed in context.analyses.

stimulus.label: Stimulus / netlist
stimulus.goal:
Write the runnable testbench BODY for each test: sources, load, DUT instance and analysis commands. Rules: ground node is 0; instantiate the DUT as 'X0 <ports in order> <subckt_name>' (port order is context.circuit.ports); for a single supply use VSS=0 and VDD=context.technology.vdd; set the input common mode to about VDD/2; do NOT write .lib, .inc, .end or .subckt (the system adds them); do NOT write .meas (the measure agent writes them); take analysis parameters from context.analyses[].params. Each testbench is a separate, self-contained file. IMPORTANT: do NOT use placeholders ({...}, 'context.', etc.); write all numbers literally. Example AC testbench body (VDD=1.2 V, DUT ports vinp vinn vout vdd vss): 'Vdd vdd 0 1.2
Vss vss 0 0
Vcm cm 0 0.6
Vin vinp cm DC 0 AC 0.5
Vinn vinn cm DC 0 AC -0.5
X0 vinp vinn vout vdd vss da
Cl vout 0 0.5p
.ac dec 20 1 1e9'. This is only a format example; adapt port order and names to your own circuit.

measure.label: Ölçüm
measure.goal: Write only the .meas lines for each testbench and state the expected range. Metric names MUST be the SAME as context.analyses[].metrics (e.g. gain, phase_margin). Use the node names from the testbench. Do NOT write .end in measurement lines. The statement field must be a complete '.meas ...' line; use '\n' for several lines.

verify.label: Doğrulama (oylama + kural)
verify.goal: Cluster the simulation results, apply the rule checks and select the winning candidate.

report.label: Rapor
report.goal: Describe the result briefly and correctly. Do not invent new numbers; use only the values in the verify output.
